name: trackiq-amazon-sales-movers
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Sales Movers and Root Cause
summary: Ranks an Amazon catalogue by how much each product's revenue moved between two periods and decomposes every mover into its cause — traffic, conversion rate, units per order, or average selling price — so the answer is "sessions fell 31%", not "sales are down".
